title: Fidel Castro y la revolución
goal: Read how the 1953 Moncada attack, the 1956 Granma landing, and two years of guerrilla war in the Sierra Maestra ended up toppling Batista on January 1, 1959.
grammar: Acabar por + infinitivo: cómo terminó un proceso

items: Explain where Castro's armed group ended up landing in December 1956.
Describe what the few survivors ended up doing in the Sierra Maestra.
Explain what happened to Batista's regime during the guerrilla war.
Use acabar por + infinitive to trace a winding process to its outcome.
